title: PolicyPack
description: Declarative policy pack evaluated against agent-receipt Markdown. YAML and JSON use the same fields. apiVersion is exactly agent-receipt/policy/v1. The matcher is deterministic: AND across match keys, OR within a list. There is no Rego engine and no eval. Unknown keys, duplicate rule ids, and bad globs fail lint. A missing, unreadable, or invalid pack fails closed.

name.description: Pack name recorded on each hit.

extends.description: Packs composed depth-first before this pack's own rules. builtin:<name> or a path relative to this file. The same rule id later in the chain overrides the earlier one. A cycle fails closed. Depth limit is 8.

rules.description: Own rules. A pack needs rules, extends, or both.

id.description: Unique in this file. The same id via extends is an override, not a duplicate.

action.description: deny fails the gate (exit 2). warn is reported and does not change the exit code.

match.description: Every present key must match (AND). A list matches when any entry matches (OR). An empty match is a lint error.

network.description: A command that starts a network client (curl, wget, ssh, and the same set).

unsigned.description: Receipt has no valid signature sidecar.

redactionDisabled.description: The receipt body does not contain the redaction marker.

risk.description: Receipt risk at or above this level. critical is not a receipt risk and is a lint error.

maxBytes.description: Matches when the receipt body is strictly larger.

patternList.description: Command text. A glob by default. Prefix regex: or use /pattern/flags (flags i, m, s only, source at most 200 characters).

globList.description: Path or name globs. ** must be its own path segment. An unclosed [ is a lint error.

exitCode.description: An integer, nonzero, non-zero, any, or a list of those.

exception.description: Lives in .agent-receipt.yml under policyExceptions, not inside the pack file. path is a glob. expires is YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). The exception applies on that date and is expired when the date is before today. An expired exception does not suppress a hit.
